name: Jurassic Fart Simulator
summary:
Jurassic Fart is a prehistoric comedy‑simulation where each dinosaur stars in their own dedicated scene, complete with unique controls and personality quirks.
Your cast now includes Trex, Raptor, Terry Dactyl, Tara Dactyl, and Bronto.
Each scene gives you its own mix of roar power, fart intensity, movement style, and any special behaviours tied to that dinosaur’s body type. Crank the fart slider and the world reacts accordingly—ground shakes, sound effects erupt, screens rumble, and the dinosaur’s environment responds with escalating absurdity.
